positions.title: Mentor, B/S/H Future Home Accelerator Powered by Techstars
Co-Founder
positions.description:
Very open for Ideas and possible collaborations

We are busier than ever, running from one meeting to the next and constantly having the pressure to fill every second. Many times this results in the fact that we forget to stand still in order to take in the precious and timeless moments we experience every day. These priceless moments we have with the people we love the most and during the exciting moments when we explore something new.

With Cara & Grace, we want to cherish these moments, want to make them feel timeless and lasting as long as possible. For this reason, none of our watches have a hand that indicates seconds. Don’t be distracted by the complexity of time, enjoy the moments you fill it with.

This is also where our name stems from, as the Latin name Cara stands for “to cherish and belove”, and the name Grace stands for “being gracious and thankful”. We want to empower everyone to live, enjoy and go further every day, and to empower others to do the same whilst cherishing and sharing their timeless moments. 

Share your timeless moments with #caraandgrace and together grow our community, one moment at a time.

positions.description:
STYLIGHT is the place to discover and shop fashion you love from the best online stores. Whenever. Wherever. Over 6 million people use STYLIGHT‘s website and app every month to discover and shop the latest fashion trends. 

The Fashion Editors of STYLIGHT and its users hand-pick the hottest trends from the best fashion stores and users can buy everything they find on STYLIGHT from the shops featured on the platform. 

Launched in August 2008, STYLIGHT is headquartered in Munich, Germany and was founded by Anselm Bauer, Benjamin Günther, Max-Josef Meier and Sebastian Schuon. Currently STYLIGHT employs over 150 people across three offices (Munich, London and New York) of which more than 50% are from nations other than Germany. Inspiration and shopping through STYLIGHT can be done in 13 countries around the globe: STYLIGHT is one of the fastest growing online fashion destinations with four different platforms, over 350 business partners worldwide and co-operating with over 6000 brands on an international scale.

company.name: Alasco
company.description:
Alasco is the financial management platform for real estate companies managing development, retrofit, and tenant improvement projects. Alasco helps real estate companies shift from reactive cost control to strategic financial management and set in place the financial data layer for a solid AI strategy.

With rapid time-to-value, the Alasco platform unites all stakeholders around a single source of truth, helping them plan, budget, analyse, optimise and execute on their business plans.

The platform is used by over 350 real estate players across Europe who collectively manage on Alasco more than €1Tn in project development volume to date. Key customers include: Hines, JLL, LaSalle, Ardian, ECE Gruppe, Alcaro Invest and Patrizia SE.
